title: Pricing · matrix (collapsible)
description: ServiceWand plan comparison matrix. 2–4 plan columns driven by column_count, four feature groups, twelve feature rows. Desktop renders a sticky-header table; the mobile breakpoint collapses into a per-plan accordion using the same parameter values.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only — grouped plan-vs-feature matrix. Second-opinion variant alongside pricing.comparison-matrix: mobile becomes a per-plan accordion (each plan is a disclosure), states drive cell glyphs (yes/no/partial/text), groups and rows can be hidden via ENUM.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — static layout first, CRM/CMS parameterization-ready numbered slots.

notes: column_count drives both the desktop grid track count and which plan columns appear in the mobile accordion.
Rows and groups can be hidden via row_NN_visible / group_NN_visible ENUMs without removing their params.
States ('yes', 'no', 'partial', 'text') drive glyph + color in the cell. Use 'text' for human-readable amounts like '50K'.
Sticky header is opt-in via overflow: auto on the table shell so the matrix can be scrolled vertically inside long pages without losing column context.
